name: Workflow AI
description: AI co-pilot for workflows — graph-read, graph-editing, layout, and run-control tools for the chat agent. The editing tools act on the workflow open in the visual editor; the run tools (wf_run_workflow_typed / wf_run_workflow_by_name / wf_list_workflows / wf_emit_workflow_event) work from any chat or IM session without an editor. All tools are offered in every chat while the plugin is enabled.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: The tools run in the renderer: editing tools act on the open editor, and run tools use the same workflow runtime as the toolbar's Run button. Workflow nodes that need the desktop (terminal, sidecar agent turns) fail inside the run, not in the tool.

mobile.reason: Same renderer tools as the browser; editing tools need a workflow editor open on the device, and desktop-only nodes fail inside the run.

permissionJustifications.workflow:read: Reads the open editor's graph, validation, last run, the node catalog, templates, and your published workflows.
permissionJustifications.canvas:write: Applies the agent's graph edits, proposals, and auto-layout to the workflow open in the editor (undoable, like your own edits).
permissionJustifications.canvas:run: Runs a workflow when you approve the agent's run request, and wakes a waiting run with an event.
permissionJustifications.session:read: Checks whether the chat is bound to an IM conversation before offering an in-chat run or subscribe card.
permissionJustifications.connectors:send: Records the Approve / Cancel callback for the run or subscribe card it posts into an IM conversation.
permissionJustifications.database:read: Lists your characters, twins, teams, skills, connectors, MCP servers, and plugins so the agent can reference real ones in a node's settings.
